record.name: DAON LAB Live-Commerce Skincare Advertising Rules

rules.title: Disease and Skin Disorder Claims Prohibition
rules.description: Hosts must not state or imply that the product treats, heals, cures, or manages skin diseases or medical conditions, including eczema, dermatitis, acne, acne scars, or pigmentation disorders.
unacceptable_examples: This cream will treat your eczema and soothe dermatitis flare-ups.
Use this ampoule to clear up acne and heal stubborn acne scars.
It is formulated to treat chronic skin diseases and pigmentation disorders.
rules.say_instead_hint: Focus purely on cosmetic benefits, such as relieving the sensation of dryness or supporting an even-looking complexion.

evidence.quote: Treats eczema, dermatitis, acne or any skin disease.
Treats acne, acne scars, pigmentation disorders or any skin disease.

rules.title: Medicinal and Prescription Product Claims Prohibition
rules.description: Hosts must not claim or imply that the cosmetic product acts like a medicine, drug, or prescription product.
unacceptable_examples: This works just like a prescription product from the clinic.
It acts like a topical medicine to repair your barrier.
You do not need a pharmaceutical ointment because this works just like medicine.
rules.say_instead_hint: Describe the item strictly as a cosmetic skincare product for daily hydration and moisture support.

evidence.quote: Works like a medicine or a prescription product.

rules.title: Skin Healing and Cellular Regeneration Prohibition
rules.description: Hosts must not claim that the product repairs, heals, or cures damaged skin, or that it regenerates skin cells. Not this rule: Stating that the product helps support the skin's moisture barrier or soothes the feeling of dryness is permitted.
unacceptable_examples: This cream actively repairs and heals damaged skin.
It penetrates deep to regenerate skin cells overnight.
Apply this to quickly heal broken or peeling skin.
rules.say_instead_hint: Say that the product helps support the skin's moisture barrier or helps relieve the feeling of dryness.

evidence.quote: Repairs, heals or cures damaged skin.
Repairs, heals or regenerates skin cells.

rules.title: Wrinkle Removal and Age Reversal Prohibition
rules.description: Hosts must not state or imply that the product removes wrinkles or reverses the ageing process of the skin. Not this rule: Claiming to help reduce the look of fine dryness lines is permitted.
unacceptable_examples: This ampoule removes wrinkles in just four weeks.
Turn back time and completely reverse skin ageing.
Erase your deep lines and look ten years younger instantly.
rules.say_instead_hint: State that the product helps reduce the look of fine dryness lines or promotes a radiant appearance.

evidence.quote: Removes wrinkles or reverses skin ageing.
Removes wrinkles or reverses skin ageing.

rules.title: Skin Whitening and Permanent Tone Change Prohibition
rules.description: Hosts must not claim that the product whitens skin or permanently alters skin colour. Not this rule: Stating that the product helps skin look more radiant and even-toned with continued use is permitted.
unacceptable_examples: This will whiten your complexion by three shades.
It permanently changes your skin colour to look brighter.
Get permanent skin whitening with just one dropper.
rules.say_instead_hint: State that the product helps skin look more radiant and even-toned with continued use.

evidence.quote: Whitens skin, or permanently changes skin colour.

rules.title: Absolute Safety and Pregnancy Safety Prohibition
rules.description: Hosts must not claim that the product is completely safe for everyone or unconditionally safe during pregnancy. Because the products have not been specifically tested on pregnant or breastfeeding women, hosts must advise pregnant and breastfeeding customers to consult their doctor before use.
unacceptable_examples: This formula is completely safe for everyone without exception.
It is 100% safe to use during pregnancy and breastfeeding.
There is zero risk of irritation, even for pregnant women.
rules.say_instead_hint: Advise customers who are pregnant or breastfeeding to consult their doctor before use, and avoid universal safety guarantees.

evidence.quote: Completely safe for everyone, or safe during pregnancy.
Customers who are pregnant or breastfeeding should consult their doctor before use.
Completely safe for everyone, or safe during pregnancy.

rules.title: Permanent Results Prohibition
rules.description: Hosts must not claim permanent results or results that persist without continued use. Cosmetic benefits are temporary and require ongoing application.
unacceptable_examples: Your skin will stay hydrated forever even if you stop using it.
This provides permanent results without continued use.
Once your skin barrier is fixed, you never need moisturiser again.
rules.say_instead_hint: State that results require continued use and regular daily application.

evidence.quote: Permanent results, or results without continued use.
Permanent results, or results without continued use.

rules.title: Comparative and Superlative Claims Restriction
rules.description: Hosts must not use unverified superlative or comparative claims that claim superiority over other market products or market-wide supremacy.
unacceptable_examples: This is the best moisturiser in Singapore.
Our formula is stronger than any other ampoule on the market.
This provides better hydration than any competitor brand in the country.
rules.say_instead_hint: Highlight the product's specific features, texture, and tested formula without claiming market supremacy or disparaging competitors.

evidence.quote: Comparative or superlative claims, such as "the best moisturiser in Singapore".
Comparative or superlative claims, such as "stronger than any other ampoule".

rules.title: In-House Test Qualification Requirement
rules.description: Performance metrics, duration of hydration, patch testing outcomes, and participant survey results originating from internal studies must explicitly state the mandatory qualifying phrase 'in our in-house test' during the broadcast.
unacceptable_examples: Helps keep skin hydrated for up to 24 hours.
Patch tested with no irritation reactions across all participants.
26 of 30 participants said their skin looked more radiant after 4 weeks.
rules.say_instead_hint: Include the mandatory qualifying phrase 'in our in-house test' alongside any study findings or metrics.

evidence.quote: Claims marked * must be said together with "in our in-house test".
Claims marked * must be said together with "in our in-house test".
